manifest.description: Swap EVM assets on Uniswap. A view over uniswap_backend, which composes the reusable EVM modules.
manifest.name: uniswap_ui

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Uniswap price oracle + swap router: V2/V3/V4 token prices (best-rate, Multicall3-batched) and V2/V3 swap building. Multi-chain, configurable.
manifest.name: uniswap_module

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: The Uniswap app's backend: quotes, swaps and swap history composed from reusable EVM chain, token, asset, account, fee, quote and sender modules. Holds no key material.
manifest.name: uniswap_backend

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: The one EVM transaction sender on the device: one nonce ledger, call bundles approved as one decision in the keystore, ordered broadcast, and a write-ahead local history. Holds no key material and chooses no chain.
manifest.name: tx_sender_module

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Device-wide token catalogue and enabled set: built-in defaults, extra list URLs, custom tokens, and the ERC-20s shared by every Logos wallet on this device.
manifest.name: token_list_ui

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Reusable EVM token catalogue, enabled snapshots, pinned assets and paged picker. Proxyable, fail-closed.
manifest.name: token_list_module

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Run and manage a local Monero node: sync progress, peers, settings and the node log.
manifest.name: monerod_ui

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Runs a Monero node in-process: per-network config, start, stop, status and log tail.
manifest.name: monerod_module

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Headless Monero wallet for monero_wallet_backend: open or create a wallet, read the balance and addresses, build a transfer, review it and broadcast or withdraw it, all over `logosctl call`. Holds the custodian and approver roles, so a bare CLI (the host anchor) can do none of it.
manifest.name: monero_wallet_cli

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Proxyable, fail-closed monerod JSON-RPC client. Per-network config (endpoint + proxy); socks5h/Tor-ready. Never runs a node itself; local mode dials the one monerod_module runs.
manifest.name: monero_node_module

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Keystore: scrypt vaults, BIP39/BIP32 HD derivation, secp256k1 signing. No network; private keys never leave the module.
manifest.name: keystore_module

manifest.description: EIP-1559 fee suggestion for EVM chains: slow/normal/fast tiers derived from eth_feeHistory, with custom overrides.
manifest.name: fee_module

manifest.description: The signing approval surface: shows what a module asked to sign, in the keystore's own words, and takes the vault password.
manifest.name: evm_signer_ui

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Headless approver for keystore_module: shows what a module asked to sign, in the keystore's own words, over `logosctl watch`, and takes the decision over `logosctl call`.
manifest.name: evm_signer_cli

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: The one place accounts are created, imported, exported and deleted. Every other surface only reads which accounts exist.
manifest.name: evm_keystore_ui

manifest.author: Logos Core Team
manifest.description: Headless custodian for keystore_module: creates, imports, exports and deletes accounts over `logosctl call`. Every other headless surface only reads which accounts exist.
manifest.name: evm_keystore_cli

manifest.description: Reusable native and ERC-20 asset rows, balances, transfer building, and transaction-history decoration.
